meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装、发现并接入 HyperFrames 组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用 HyperFrames 开发,需要装组件或开发新组件
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build with HyperFrames and need component management or authoring

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能识别并执行 hyperframes add / catalog 命令，安装注册表中的块或组件；也能根据说明把已安装内容接入 index.html（如设置 data-composition-src 等属性），或处理 hyperframes.json 配置，并支持将新块/组件按贡献流程提交 PR。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperframes add”或“hyperframes catalog”等相关命令，或要求安装/发现注册表中的块和组件、把已安装内容接入 index.html、处理 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 data-chart 这个块
搜索一下有哪些适合揭示标题的组件
把已安装的 grain-overlay 组件接到我的组合里
say.note: 会读取组件文件并指导粘贴 HTML/CSS/JS。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can run `hyperframes add` and `hyperframes catalog` to install or discover registry blocks and components, wire installed items into index.html with required attributes, handle hyperframes.json, and follow the contributing workflow to submit new items as PRs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run or mention `hyperframes add`, `hyperframes catalog`, or ask to install/discover registry items, wire installed content into index.html, or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Install the block data-chart for me.
say_en.note: Runs hyperframes add and reports written files and snippet.

say_en.text: Find components that reveal a headline line by line.
say_en.note: Runs hyperframes catalog --query and ranks matches.

say_en.text: Wire the installed grain-overlay component into my composition.
say_en.note: Reads the file and guides pasting HTML/CSS/JS.
